La Tabaski à Ouagadougou

Type
Article de presse
Publisher
Carrefour africain
Date
April 9, 1966
Language
Français
Description
Muslims in Haute-Volta celebrated Eid al-Adha, or Tabaski, on Saturday, April 2. In Ouagadougou, the head of state attended the main prayer at Place d’Armes, followed by the ritual sacrifice of a sheep by the capital’s chief imam.
